Title: Encoded PowerShell Command Execution
Description: Detects PowerShell executing with encoded commands, a common defense evasion technique used by malware and penetration testing tools.
Author: EdrBrain
FalsePositives: Enterprise automation tools using encoded commands for script transport

Title: MSHTA Executing Remote or Local Script
Description: Detects mshta.exe executing HTA files, a common LOLBin technique for initial access and defense evasion. Legitimate mshta usage is extremely rare in enterprise environments.
Author: EdrBrain
FalsePositives: Very rare legitimate HTA application usage

Title: Certutil Used for File Download
Description: Detects certutil.exe with download-related flags, commonly abused by malware to download payloads while blending in with legitimate certificate utility usage.
Author: EdrBrain

Title: Rundll32 Loading Suspicious DLL
Description: Detects rundll32.exe loading DLLs from user-writable or temporary directories, a common pattern for DLL side-loading and execution of malicious payloads.
Author: EdrBrain
FalsePositives: Legitimate software installers using rundll32 for DLL registration

Title: BITS Job Abuse for Download
Description: Detects bitsadmin.exe used to transfer files, a technique abused by malware to download payloads using a legitimate Windows service that bypasses some network monitoring.
Author: EdrBrain
FalsePositives: SCCM and Windows Update using BITS for legitimate transfers
